steps.title: Open Slack API dashboard
steps.detail: Navigate to https://api.slack.com/apps in a browser.

steps.title: Create a new app
steps.detail: Click “Create New App”, choose “From scratch”, enter an App Name and select the Development Slack Workspace, then click “Create App”.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URLs
steps.detail: In the left‑hand menu select “OAuth & Permissions”, scroll to “Redirect URLs”, click “Add a Redirect URL”, paste your app’s redirect URI (must be HTTPS), and click “Save URLs”.

steps.title: Add required scopes
steps.detail: Still on “OAuth & Permissions”, under “Bot Token Scopes” click “Add an OAuth Scope” and select each scope your app needs (e.g., chat:write, channels:read).

steps.title: Save scope changes
steps.detail: Click the “Save Changes” button at the bottom of the page to persist the added scopes.

steps.title: Install the app to your workspace
steps.detail: In the left menu select “Install App”, then click “Install to Workspace”. Review the permission prompt and click “Allow”.

steps.title: Copy credentials
steps.detail: After installation, return to “Basic Information” and copy the Client ID, Client Secret, and the Bot User OAuth Token for use in your code.

nuances.title: Redirect URI must be HTTPS
nuances.detail: Slack only accepts HTTPS URLs for OAuth redirect endpoints; using HTTP will cause the OAuth flow to fail.

nuances.title: Scope approval may require admin consent
nuances.detail: If the selected scopes are considered sensitive (e.g., admin.*, files:*), a workspace admin must approve them before the app can be installed.

nuances.title: Rate limits on token generation
nuances.detail: Slack enforces rate limits on OAuth token requests; excessive retries can lead to temporary blocks.

nuances.title: App visibility vs. public distribution
nuances.detail: Apps created for personal use are private to the workspace; publishing to the Slack App Directory requires a separate review process.

whenBlocked.situation: Workspace admin has disabled third‑party app installations
whenBlocked.action: Ask the workspace admin to enable app installations in the workspace settings or to grant you permission to install apps
whenBlocked.contact: Slack workspace admin or Slack support at https://slack.com/help/contact

openQuestions.whyItMatters: Cost impacts budgeting for developers deploying production‑grade integrations.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Review Slack's pricing page and any tiered feature documentation.
